newsitem.title: USA: Culligan Water hooks up with GE Appliances.
newsitem.headline: Culligan Water hooks up with GE Appliances.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Thursday it entered a partnership with General Electric Co's GE Appliances to provide water filtration assemblies for a new line of GE products.

The partnership provides for the "Water by Culligan" logo to be displayed on the new GE refrigerator product and is part of Culligan's strategy of working with equipment makers to build new distribution channels, the company said.
The new GE refrigerator product is part of a full line of appliances to be introduced in GE's new series of GE Profile Performance appliances, according to a statement released by both companies.

"Our partnership with GE Appliances, as well as our previously announced partnerships with Health-o-Meter and Moen Inc, give the Culligan brand a whole new presence in the home water filtration segment," said Douglas Pertz, Culligan's president and chief executive.
"It remains our goal to grow the water filtration category by continually seeking ways to bring innovative water filtration solutions to our customers," he said.
